scope: A disposable Kubernetes v1.36.1 Kind cluster runs a digest-pinned Versity v1.9.0 S3 gateway on a case-owned local-path PVC. It stores three non-sensitive synthetic AI artifact classes as exact, versioned S3 objects in historical, corrected, and independent healthy-comparator buckets. Jobs use the pinned AWS CLI bundle through a Python runtime mount, read live Object Lock configuration and version-specific retention/head/get responses, including the measured policy extension on older versions. A scoped cleanup probe removes an unlocked comparator and receives a denial for the three retained versions. Production governance, deployed lifecycle rules and long-term durability require separate evidence.

checks.claim: The pinned Versity gateway uses its case-owned local-path PVC
All three fixture buckets expose versioning and Object Lock
Live version-specific retention exposes the historical shortfall in every class
Corrected version retention meets each class threshold and matches the healthy comparator
The exact source bytes are retrievable from each independently versioned bucket object
Retention is corrected on the exact earlier artifact versions
Retention denies early cleanup of all three exact versions while the unlocked comparator is removed
